title: C5 AttributeRecord
description: Transcribed from Section 3.3. The pivot contract of the platform: normalized representation of a single attribute from source materials, with provenance (evidenceRefs) mandatory per invariant I1.

sourceContract.description: artefactId of the CorpusManifest artefact this was extracted from.

path.description: Dot-delimited normalised path within the source.

typeDetail.description: Tightened at Increment 3 (parsers/type_normalisation.py, Section 4.3/4.4). One shape shared across all dataTypes; every sub-field is optional and only populated by the parser idiom that produces it - see docs/contracts.md's typeDetail table.

offsetRequired.description: dateTime: whether the source format mandates a UTC offset.

refTarget.description: reference: the target this reference points to (xs:IDREF target, $ref pointer, Avro named-type reference).

choiceGroup.description: xs:choice: shared identifier for every branch of one choice group (Section 4.4).

substitutionHead.description: true on the head element of an XSD substitution group.

substitutionOf.description: On a substitution-group member: the attributeId of the head element it substitutes for.

explicitNull.description: XSD nillable="true". MUST NOT be conflated with cardinality's 0..1 (minOccurs="0").

inheritedFrom.description: xs:extension: the base type localName this attribute was flattened in from, when the region did not declare it directly.

evidenceRefs.description: Invariant I1: non-empty and every reference MUST resolve to an artefact listed in the run's CorpusManifest (cross-document; see contracts/validators.py:check_i1_evidence_resolvable).
